name: qtim
description: Codex-native bootstrap and orchestration kit for project-specific subagent teams. Role-aware setup for developers and PM/analysts. Includes explicit GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna role profiles with a Sol/Ultra team lead, mandatory clean-context Sol stress-testing for ADRs, a risk-proportional fast/full feature pipeline, debug-loop/prototype/brainstorm/grill disciplines, team workflows, onboarding, diagnostics, migrations, custom agent templates, independent review gates, durable memory, and lifecycle hooks.

interface.longDescription: qtim adapts a project into a Codex-native team workflow for developers and PM/analysts. Developers get implement/test/review loops plus bundled debug-loop, prototype, brainstorm, and grill disciplines. PM/analysts get a risk-proportional pipeline: a fast feature brief for simple S/M work or a full PRD, grounded decomposition and estimate, and vertical-slice plan in docs/features/. The main team lead runs on GPT-5.6 Sol with Ultra; role agents use explicit Sol/Terra pairs and built-in exploration uses Luna. Every ADR receives an independent clean-context Sol stress-test before approval. Setup generates a track-aware charter, custom agents and durable memory; lifecycle reminders are plugin-bundled, project PostToolUse is optional, and update migrates versioned generated state safely.
defaultPrompt: Set up qtim for this project
Run the qtim feature pipeline for this idea
Run qtim team-up for this epic
Diagnose this non-trivial bug with qtim debug-loop
